description.en: Erythrosuchus africanus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m art scale, not biological measurement. Source author2013 Fig4: BP/1/5207 skull with NHMUK R3592 and 3762a postcranium, published whole skeletal composite modified from Gower2003 by E.Lopez-Rolandi. Not a single complete specimen or scan. Soft tissue, muted color, modest jaw gape, neutral stance, digits, tail curvature artistic. Covered skull fenestrae; no armor rows.
